Abel communicated with me the entire way and the process was smooth, the crew was neat and everyone that came to my home was amazing and very collaborative and allowed me to ask questions. Thank you for an amazing experience and an amazing pool ! Stan Williams, Satisfied Customer Abel was absolutely incredible with my pool. I had a green pool with algae and other issues that i could not fix and Aqua Bella found the issue and corrected the problem. It was a broken manifold, DE in pool and debris on the bottom. Thanks for everything. Carlos M, Pool Customer This Pool Service is the best. Abel has taken care of our pool for 3 years,we never have to worry about cleaning it, putting chemicals in or havingto try to balance out chemicals, no maintenance – he does it all. reviews.text: I am new to pool ownership and for the first year made frequent trips to Leslie’s to test my pool water quality.  It seemed like I was consistently adding too much or too little of some chemical or another. Was constantly battling cloudy water or mustard algae. After a particularly bad mustard algae outbreak, I reached out to the pool company that had resurfaced our pool and was referred to Aqua Bella Pools. Abel Rubio, the owner of this small pool maintenance business responded promptly to my call and totally eradicated the algae outbreak.  At that point, I asked him to take over pool maintenance for the balance of the summer. It was my intention just to have Abel maintain the pool during the summer and then I would resume taking care of the pool.   After I saw how sparkling clear the water was with Abel’s weekly maintenance, however, I decided that it was worth it to turn over pool maintenance to a professional. I have not regretted my decision; It is totally worth the monthly fee to have Abel clean and maintain sparkling clear water quality on a weekly basis.  In addition to maintaining the pool, Abel has installed a new water circulating pump, a freeze guard for the pool, cleans the pool filter, repaired the Polaris—he is pretty much capable of addressing all aspects of pool ownership.  Abel has become my friend and trusted advisor for anything pool related.  I recommend him without hesitation to anyone needing assistance maintaining a pool.
reviews.author: MR

reviews.text: Abel and team helped get our pool up and running correctly with their pool school. As a first time pool owner, he was thoughtful and explained how easy it is to take care of your pool. He’s responsive, very professional, and willing to help. Highly recommend.
